mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the average 20-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 1.2 million units signals strong consumer confidence and rising residential investment, which correlates with elevated equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200.0, SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% per annum, combined with a stable CPIAUCSL, indicates a tightening monetary policy regime that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 1.5 and CPIAUCSL is stable, SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0, coupled with rising employment, indicates strong real sector momentum that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105.0 and PAYEMS is rising, SPX fails to deliver positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is below its 12-month MA, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, indicates accelerating inflation that triggers market expectations of future rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS is stable, SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production below 104.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 104.0 and UNRATE is rising, SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth signals a weakening economy, which increases risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%, SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
